description.value:
The hype thrall has no independent turns, actions, reactions, Strikes, or spells. Command Flash Mob grants support only, not the usual two minion actions. The thrall is stationary unless another ability moves it.

Attacks automatically hit the thrall, and it automatically fails all saving throws. It has 1 HP, is destroyed at 0 HP, and does not use dying rules. It can flank but cannot Strike.

Special The thrall grants no separate XP.

The thrall's space is difficult terrain, but other creatures can enter it as though it were unoccupied. A creature entering its space can automatically push the thrall into an adjacent space outside that creature's path.

The photographer captures Blaster's good side in a burst of magenta light. This thrall begins with @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterAuraBol01]{Bolster Aura} active: a 60-foot aura granting only its summoning Blaster 10 temporary HP added to the Flash Mob pool once during this thrall's lifetime.

Contributions from distinct thralls add together. Leaving retains the remaining temporary HP; re-entry and mode changes never refill spent HP. Already-granted HP remain after changing mode until this thrall is destroyed, removed, or expires. Higher unrelated temporary HP retain their source and duration.

@UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterCommand01]{Command Flash Mob} changes only this thrall's mode for its remaining lifetime. It gains no movement or other actions. Its destruction, removal, or expiration ends its support.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterAuraIns01]{Inspire Aura}

Its summoning Blaster gains a +1 untyped bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saves against fear while inside this thrall's 60-foot aura. Bonuses from distinct thralls stack; one thrall never supplies multiple copies of its own benefit.

The benefit ends on leaving the aura, changing this thrall's mode, or the thrall's destruction, removal, or expiration.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterAuraGrd01]{Guard Aura}

Its summoning Blaster gains a +1 untyped bonus to AC while inside this thrall's 60-foot aura. Bonuses from distinct thralls stack; one thrall never supplies multiple copies of its own benefit.

The benefit ends on leaving the aura, changing this thrall's mode, or the thrall's destruction, removal, or expiration.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterAuraBol01]{Bolster Aura}

This thrall contributes 10 temporary HP to its summoning Blaster's Flash Mob pool once during its lifetime. Contributions from distinct thralls add together. Leaving the aura retains the remaining HP; re-entry, another command, and returning to Bolster never refill spent HP.

The module tracks each contribution and removes only its unspent HP when the thrall is destroyed, removed, or expires. Changing its mode retains already-granted HP until then. Flash Mob does not add to temporary HP from unrelated sources; higher existing temporary HP retain their source and duration.

Requirements A living Flash Mob thrall linked to its summoning Blaster.

Duration the thrall's remaining lifetime, unless its mode changes

Effect The thrall emits a 60-foot aura granting @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterTempHP001]{Bolster} only to its summoning Blaster. No other creature benefits.

Each distinct thrall contributes 10 temporary HP once during its lifetime. Contributions add together in one tracked Flash Mob pool. Leaving retains unspent HP; re-entry and mode changes never refill them. Changing this thrall's mode retains already-granted HP until the thrall is destroyed, removed, or expires. Higher unrelated temporary HP retain their source and duration.

The aura and its linked benefits end if the thrall is destroyed, removed, or expires.

speed.details: Stationary unless explicitly commanded; support commands grant no movement.

details.publicNotes:
An obsessive photographer whose flashing camera feeds Blaster's vanity. The photographer captures Blaster's good side in a burst of magenta light.

A 1-HP Flash Mob thrall with no independent turns or attacks. It lasts 1 minute and grants no separate XP.

Its @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterAuraBol01]{Bolster Aura} is active from the moment it is summoned.
details.privateNotes:
Derived from PF2e Summons Assistant's built-in Thrall. Preserve the thrall trait and summoner linkage. Runtime adds owner actor/token UUIDs, a creation nonce, and the one-minute expiration marker without generating Strikes or adding an independent combatant.

Foundry Operating Notes

Support Shell

This is a 1-HP support minion with no independent actions, reactions, Strikes, spells, or XP. Level 18 is the summoning integration's scaling shell; AC and saving-throw values are placeholders. At 0 HP, it immediately ceases to support Blaster. It disappears after 1 minute. Any number of Flash Mob thralls can exist at once.

Yield the Stage

Forced displacement grants no independent movement or support command.

Native Support Auras

This thrall starts with @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterAuraBol01]{Bolster Aura} embedded and active. Hype Fans start with Inspire, Ego Guards with Guard, and Paparazzi with Bolster. Each native 60-foot aura affects only its summoning Blaster; it never affects allies or the emitter. Native area containment determines whether Blaster is inside.

Select Blaster and use @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterMobCmd001]{Command Thrall} to replace one chosen living thrall's mode while it is within 60 feet. Other thralls keep their modes. The chosen mode lasts for that thrall's remaining lifetime. Commands have no frequency or combat requirement and grant no movement.

Each thrall embeds Inspire, Guard, and Bolster receiver templates. Its aura references its own receiver UUID. Receiver templates keep their modifiers ignored and use an unmatched signature predicate. Only after validating a native received copy does runtime enable its modifiers, stamp the owner signature, and give untyped modifiers a unique emitter slug, so identical benefits from distinct thralls stack without applying receiver templates to the emitting thrall. Keep the templates and exactly one active aura; duplicating an aura on one thrall grants no additional benefit.

Inspire and Guard end when Blaster leaves their native area. Bolster contributes 10 temporary HP once per thrall lifetime to one aggregate Flash Mob pool with a spent ledger. It retains unspent HP after exit; movement, re-entry, ordinary reconciliation, and repeated commands never refill spent contributions. Changing the thrall's mode retains its already-granted HP until its lifetime ends. Destruction, removal, or expiration removes only that thrall's unspent contribution. Higher unrelated temporary HP keep their normal source and duration; Flash Mob does not add to unrelated pools.

Destroying, removing, or expiring a thrall ends its support. Preserve owner linkage, summoner signature, nonce, receiver IDs, and expiration data when repairing a summon. Manually placed, unlinked thralls cannot grant these benefits.
